youtube.title: How Can a Clock Tell a Ship Where It Is?
youtube.description:
A clock carries reference time. A corrected local solar observation and a same-instant comparison reveal longitude—not a complete position.

See how two hours ahead becomes 30° east, and where Harrison’s H4 fits into the story. Other astronomical methods remained useful too.

Original explanatory animation and H4 reconstruction; synthetic narration.
Sources: Royal Museums Greenwich — https://www.rmg.co.uk/stories/time/what-longitude and https://www.rmg.co.uk/collections/objects/rmgc-object-79142
youtube.firstComment: The clock carries reference time; observation and calculation do the locating. What other everyday object hides an unexpected idea?

tiktok.caption:
Two hours ahead → 30° east. The trick is comparing reference time with corrected local time at the same instant. A clock carries time; it does not display the ship’s position.

Original animation; synthetic narration.
tiktok.firstComment: Ahead locally = east of the reference. The two readings are simultaneous—not two hours passing on the voyage.

instagram.caption:
Time can reveal a direction in space.

Reference 12:00. Local mean time 14:00. At the same instant, that two-hour difference means 30° east of the reference.

The watch preserves time. Observation, correction and calculation reveal longitude. Save this for the next time a map makes you wonder.

Original explanatory animation and H4 reconstruction; synthetic narration.
instagram.firstComment: Both readings must use a comparable mean-solar-time basis. That is why the local Sun observation needs a correction.

facebook.title: Why a Clock Can Help Find Longitude
facebook.caption:
A ship’s clock preserves the time at a known reference. Sailors compare it with corrected local time at the same moment. Earth’s turning connects the difference to longitude: two hours ahead means 30° east.

Harrison’s H4 helped demonstrate accurate timekeeping at sea, while astronomical methods remained useful. The clock alone does not reveal a complete geographic position.

Original explanatory animation and H4 reconstruction; synthetic narration.
facebook.firstComment: The clock preserves a reference. Observation and calculation reveal longitude. What other unexpected connection should Magnivis explain next?
